nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture (pnpm workspace + Turbo)
nodes.rationale: Centralized dependency management with pnpm workspaces, Turbo for optimized task orchestration and caching, Biome for unified linting/formatting, Lefthook for git hooks; chosen to eliminate duplicate dependencies and unify code style across backend and frontend packages

nodes.label: Backend Layered Architecture (Models -> Services -> Controllers -> Plugins)
nodes.rationale: Fastify backend with controllers and plugins auto-loaded from their directories; authorization is centralized in the service layer so controllers never access models directly

nodes.label: BaseAuthorizedService Authorization Pattern
nodes.rationale: Project-scoped access control built into the base service class via ensureAccessToProject, ensureAccessToEnvironment and ensureAccessToDeployment, so every business operation carries authorization by construction

nodes.label: Multi-provider Authentication (Local JWT, Auth0, Google OAuth, Azure EntraID, API keys)
Backend Service Pattern
nodes.rationale: Services extend BaseAuthorizedService and receive the databaseUser in the constructor so authorization checks are available to all business logic

nodes.label: Backend Controller Pattern (auto-loaded Fastify routes)
nodes.rationale: Controllers are auto-loaded, access the user via request.databaseUser and delegate all database operations to services; direct model access in controllers is forbidden

nodes.label: ApiStatusHandler Data Fetching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Page components always wrap content in ApiStatusHandler with React Query queries so loading and error states are handled uniformly across the frontend
